The JSON parser and UTF-8 decoder in rust/mirage-rs/src/jq/ follow
src/jv_parse.c, src/jv.c, src/jv_unicode.c and src/jv_utf8_tables.h of jq
1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq); its evaluator (syntax.rs, compile.rs,
vm.rs, builtin.rs, host.rs, time.rs, value.rs and builtin.jq) follows src/lexer.l,
src/parser.y, src/compile.c, src/execute.c, src/exec_stack.h,
src/builtin.c, src/builtin.jq, src/jv_aux.c, src/jv_print.c and the
callbacks of src/main.c and src/util.c, and its
test corpus (corpus.json) holds the programs and inputs of tests/jq.test;
the input reader in
python/mirage/core/jq/stream.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/core/jq/stream.ts follows its src/util.c; and
the option loop, the main loop and the exit statuses of
python/mirage/commands/builtin/generic/jq.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/builtin/generic/jq.ts follow its
src/main.c. jq carries this notice:
